messages:
maya: quick note — 1.7% tail latency regression observed in nightly loadtest vs replay harness this morning :eyes:
sam: which test? synthetic or replay?
maya: replay: 1k concurrent sessions, model=mosaicv2-8b, cfg: batch_size=8, kv_enabled=true, kernel_selector=auto
maya: baseline image: rwi/inference:2026-03-10-cuda12.1 ; suspect image: rwi/inference:2026-03-12-cuda12.3
kevin: did driver pkg change? gpu type same?
perf-bot: build-info: image=rwi/inference:2026-03-12-cuda12.3, cuda=12.3, driver=535.54, cudnn=8.4, kernel_flags="--use_tf32=true"
maya: gpu=a100-sxm4-80gb across both runs
sam: can you paste perf flame or top-line numbers?
maya: p95 latency baseline 42ms -> 43.7ms; p99 120->129 ; cpu side tail stable. GPU kernels show +3.4% cycles on attention_wgrad kernel
jli: can you run replay with `--kernel-selector=force:sm_80:int8` to check fallback?
maya: trying now, kicking off: `./harness/replay --script=1000_sessions.json --env=prod-like --image=rwi/inference:2026-03-12-cuda12.3 --override="kernel_selector=force:sm_80:int8"`
ops-bot: deploy started for image rwi/inference:2026-03-12-cuda12.3 on testbed-07 (job 4723)
maya: quick profile snippet from nsys:
```text
GPU 20.9%  attention_fwd  1.23s
GPU 24.3%  attention_wgrad 1.43s
GPU 12.1%  softmax 0.71s
```
sam: looks like kernel selection caused more wgrad work. Could be kv cache eviction pattern?
kevin: kv size identical? eviction count?
maya: eviction=0 but KV cache misses +12% during rollout windows
jli: hypothesis: newer driver changed cache block allocator alignment -> different kernel tiling chosen
maya: if that's true we should force the kernel selector and re-run apples-to-apples
sam: agreed. list of parity checklist items I want: GPU model, MIG config, driver version, cudnn, container image, kernel flags, CUDA env vars, NUMA, cpuset. Add pointer to infra runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/loadtest-parity
maya: created replay job 4724 with forced kernel selector. will report.
kevin: if regression persists after forcing, let's open perf/regress ticket and include nsys traces + kernel selection tables
maya: ok will attach traces. thanks :thumbsup:
